According to the course material, how many categories of virtue are there? (answer in figures)
two

There are two categories of virtue: intellectual and moral (Aristotle 1926). "Intellectual virtue in the main owes both its birth and its growth to teaching (for which reason it requires experience and time) while moral virtue comes about as a result of habit.
